name: Springtide Ventures
decision_note: Prague-based venture arm of KKCG investing group capital in Israeli/European cyber, cloud and AI SaaS; provided an USD 8m convertible loan in ThreatMark's USD 23m round (January 2025).

evidence.quote: Established in 2014, Springtide Ventures is a 100% subsidiary of KKCG Group.
Our investments typically range between one and ten million US dollars.
Over time Springtide has adopted an investment strategy focused on SaaS companies providing products in Cyber Security, Cloud Infrastructure, Horizontal AI/ML and Blockchain.
We have a presence in Europe (Prague), Israel (Tel-Aviv) and the USA (Boston).

Z toho patnáct milionů dolarů pochází od evropského fondu Octopus Ventures a amerického Riverside Acceleration Capital, dalších osm milionů dolarů startup získal ve formě konvertibilního úvěru od českého fondu Springtide Ventures miliardáře Karla Komárka.

Springtide Ventures is a forward-thinking investment firm dedicated to identifying and nurturing promising startups poised to revolutionize select industries, including cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure.

analyst_notes: Discovered via CzechCrunch (2025-01-07, ThreatMark). Corporate VC: 100% subsidiary of KKCG investing solely KKCG's own capital (website), hence corporate flag and capital not_disclosed (no fund size; balance-sheet of the parent not published for this arm). ThreatMark round: USD 23m total, of which USD 15m equity from Octopus Ventures and Riverside Acceleration Capital and USD 8m convertible loan from Springtide; Springtide's instrument is a convertible (quasi-equity, I2). The ticket range USD 1-10m is the website statement; a 2016 CzechCrunch article cited EUR 1-5m (superseded). Website news page has no items after June 2023; activity in the window rests on the ThreatMark deal. Springtide also commits to third-party funds (Rockaway Blockchain Fund, Jazz Venture Partners) - LP activity, not counted. Two former Springtide partners now run Tachles VC (separate dossier).
